channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: France accuses Iran of cyberattack on supermarket fridges
item.description: Paris says a cyber unit linked to Iran's Revolutionary Guard was behind hack, which hit more than 1,000 stores.

item.title: Trump says Iran is sealed off. But can new US task force stop weapons flow?
item.description: Analysts say a small intelligence-focused unit cannot seal Iran’s borders, and others warn it could expand the war.

item.title: IRGC strikes three tankers near Hormuz over ‘US links’
item.description: An oil tanker caught fire near the Strait of Hormuz after Iran’s IRGC said it had struck three tankers on Sunday,

item.title: Iran stands by demands to end the war as US ramps up military pressure
item.description: Talks aimed at preventing new major fighting between the US and Iran are ongoing.

item.title: Syria confirms sending troops to Saudi Arabia amid battle against Houthis
item.description: Syrian officials deny reports Damascus is sending troops to Yemen, but Syrian security integration appears under way

item.title: Sudan teachers go on strike over meagre salaries and dilapidated schools
item.description: Teachers across the country say their pay no longer covers basic living costs.

item.title: Gaza authorities slam global ‘inaction’ after mudslide kills five people
item.description: Four children and a woman were killed after heavy rain caused a sandbank to collapse on their tent.

item.title: France accuses Iran of supermarket fridge hacking
item.description: The cyber-attack last month saw fridges and freezers in hundreds of supermarkets across France heated up.

item.title: Krakow shooting suspect has died in hospital, police say
item.description: Six people were killed in the shooting, and three bodies of the suspect's family members were found at their home.

item.title: Four killed in Gaza after sand embankment collapses onto tents, health ministry says
item.description: Three children are among those killed in the incident that came a day after heavy rain reportedly flooded tens of thousands of tents across Gaza.
